interpretation: Full run against a connected adapter; the overall weighted score is reportable.
ranking_non_claims: No plan is 'optimal' in a global sense; only best among those supplied.
Every plan that moves a payment or a collection requires the counterparty's agreement.
Financing actions are illustrations: availability, approval and pricing are unknown.

ranking_objectives.cautious: Hard payroll/critical-supplier/restricted-category constraints first; then minimise the reserve funding gap; then the payment-first intraday gap; then borrowing drawn; then total financing cost; then the number of actions. Best among the evaluated plans only - not a globally optimal solution, and conditional on counterparties agreeing.
